facts.fact: 旧护照照片里是二十多岁、已显发胖、留着金色爆炸头发型的 Wacker。
facts.anchor: It was Wacker in his late twenties, already plump and sporting a large blonde Afro-style hairdo.

facts.fact: Wacker 递给 KRAY 一份报纸文章的复印件。
facts.anchor: Wacker handed KRAY a photocopy of a newspaper article.

facts.fact: KRAY 说 GOOWIKI 是要以非传统、站外身份掩护把一批人送出去当 NOC。
facts.anchor: GOOWIKI is about getting a bunch of guys out as NOCs, under nontraditional, out-of-station cover.

facts.fact: KRAY 把一枚 Wacker 的挑战币悄悄滑进自己夹克口袋。
facts.anchor: He slipped the coin into his jacket pocket.

facts.fact: Wacker 说有二百亿美元需要分配出去。
facts.anchor: We have twenty billion dollars we need to allocate.

facts.fact: Wacker 要求 KRAY 从今天起一个月内交出一份计划。
facts.anchor: One month from today I want you to give me a plan

facts.fact: KRAY 的父亲曾是海军陆战队王牌战斗机飞行员，是最早获选飞鹞式 AV-8A 跳式喷气机的人之一。
facts.anchor: KRAY’s dad had been a kick-ass Marine Corps fighter pilot, one of the first chosen to fly the Hawker Siddeley AV-8A Harrier “Jump Jet.”

facts.fact: Wacker 警告 KRAY 不许再像今天那样在员工面前让他难堪。
facts.anchor: “Oh, and KRAY, one more thing. Don’t you ever embarrass me in front of my staff again like you did today with your stupid pseudonym nameplates idea.”
